title: CommonTrace Trace
description: The universal, agent-agnostic unit of captured experience. Shape is aligned 1:1 with the CommonTrace Hub's live trace object (search_traces / get_trace / contribute_trace) so a local trace and a Hub trace are the same object at different sync states.

id.description: UUID once assigned by the Hub. Locally-only traces MAY use a temporary local id (e.g. a YYYY-MM-DD_<slug> string) until synced.

title.description: Short description of what this trace solves (< ~120 chars recommended).

context_text.description: The problem context: what the agent was trying to do, and the situation it was in.

solution_text.description: What worked. The reusable part of the experience.

tags.description: Free-form categorization tags. No closed taxonomy at the protocol level -- see protocol/PROTOCOL.md#7-taxonomy-open-not-closed for recommended starter tags per agent_type.

agent_type.description: The kind of agent that produced this trace. Open vocabulary; 'code' is the reference implementation shipped in this repo.

profile.description: Optional name of a domain-specific extension profile that governs the `extensions` payload (e.g. 'code-review' for the Alpha/A/B/Omega/Lambda pipeline shipped in SKILL.md).

extensions.description: Profile-specific metadata that does not generalize across agent types (e.g. commit_sha, verdict, n_iterations for the code-review profile). MUST be ignored by any consumer that does not recognize `profile`.

watch_condition.description: Human-readable condition that would make this trace stale (e.g. 'React 19 release').

review_after.description: ISO-8601 datetime after which this trace should be re-validated.

supersedes_trace_id.description: UUID of an older trace this one replaces.

contributor.description: Opaque contributor identity as returned by the Hub (e.g. 'anon-89454a4a'). Not a real identity.

trust.description: Hub-computed reputation score in [0.0, 1.0], derived from votes/amendments. Read-only: never set by a client on contribute.

retrievals.description: Hub-computed usage counter (how often this trace was surfaced/used). Read-only. Local equivalent: Lesson.uses.

votes.description: Vote records. Read-only summary; individual votes are cast via vote_trace, not written directly.

related.description: Hub-computed relationships to other traces (e.g. CO_RETRIEVED, SUPERSEDES, AMENDS). Read-only.

outcome.description: Optional business-outcome data for this trace's underlying task, used to compute the five pilot metrics in protocol/PROTOCOL.md#12-pilot-outcome-metrics (repeated-error rate, resolution rate, escalation rate, frustration rate, token/LLM-call cost). Agent-agnostic: 'resolved' means a closed ticket, a won deal, a passed test suite, or an approved campaign depending on agent_type. Absent/null fields are simply excluded from the corresponding rate, not treated as false.

resolved.description: Did the underlying task reach a successful conclusion without further human correction?

escalated.description: Did the underlying task require human escalation?

repeated_error.description: Is this trace a recurrence of a previously captured failure pattern (i.e. the fleet made the same mistake twice)?

frustration_signal.description: Was there an explicit negative signal tied to this trace (complaint, downvote, low CSAT, escalation-with-anger)?

tokens_used.description: Input+output tokens consumed producing the underlying task's outcome.

llm_calls.description: Number of LLM calls made producing the underlying task's outcome.

baseline.description: True if this trace was captured during a pre-CommonTrace baseline measurement window (see "Deploying to Production" in README.md), for before/after comparison. False (default) means it was captured with CommonTrace lesson injection active.
